performed_by: separate read-only data-engineer agent on the same local host
method: Parse the 398-entry manifest, reject duplicates and unsafe paths, sequentially SHA-256 hash every complete local file, compare all 398 hashes with the freshly fetched publisher manifest, and compare all 394 EDF hashes with the access-controlled 197-pair readiness receipt.
privacy: Public summary contains no per-file paths, participant IDs, EDF headers, signals or labels. Executed arguments, exit status and aggregate results are retained in the access-controlled receipt identified by hash.
limitations: The publisher HTTPS manifest was not verified against a digital signature.
Byte agreement does not establish correct annotation timing, scoring, model performance or clinical validity.
A public clone cannot reconstruct the protected readiness crosswalk without the original dataset and access-controlled receipt.
